Oklahoma: what's on the November 3, 2026 ballot

Every candidate below is listed alphabetically, with party shown as text only. Open a name for their stated positions, background and recent news, each with sources.

Open Oklahoma on the map

Key dates

  • Voter registration deadline: October 9, 2026. Online, in-person and mailed applications are all due October 9. Mailed applications must be postmarked by that date.
  • Last day to request an absentee ballot: October 19, 2026. Your request must be received by your county election board or the State Election Board by 5 p.m. on Monday, October 19.
  • Early voting (in-person absentee): October 28, 2026 to October 31, 2026. Wednesday through Friday, October 28-30, from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m.; Saturday, October 31, from 8 a.m. to 2 p.m.
  • Election Day: November 3, 2026. Polls are open 7 a.m. to 7 p.m.

Official election information: Oklahoma State Election Board

Who's running

Only the U.S. Senate and governor races are loaded so far. Other statewide offices, ballot measures, U.S. House and local races aren't loaded yet. Check your sample ballot for the full list.

United States Senator

Open seat, formerly held by Markwayne Mullin. Appointed Sen. Alan Armstrong cannot run under state law. The winner fills the rest of the current term and the next six-year term.
